method: 1-minute bars, consolidated feed, over each trade's actual holding window. Bars start AT the entry timestamp, so the partial bar containing the fill is excluded — this understates excursions and therefore undercounts killed winners, biasing against the hypothesis under test.

winner_max_adverse_excursion_pct.note: all five well inside the 1.2% stop; smallest headroom is 2.0x

verdict: The 1.2% entry stop would not have closed a single winning trade. The stop-width concern raised earlier on 2026-08-10 is falsified and retracted.
